passage: Here’s a change to today’s tile trail. We usually ask you to make a pencil rubbing of one of the old tiles, but the walls are wet. Use a photo instead. Please take it from the pavement and keep the whole border in the picture. The volunteer at the last stop will use the border to match it with our booklet. If you don’t have a phone, borrow a picture card from me now. Don’t worry about guessing which tile you’ll see. We have a card for every stop, and you can trade yours at the last table.

title: Questions 83–85
